text: At bell 50 I moved option 3 in the council. At bell 54 a Strike Order was adopted. At bell 56 an army of 400 troops arrived from (-2,-1). At bell 57 my sawmill was finished. At bell 60 my army cleared the camp at (2,-3) and my nation's Strike Order opened at (2,-3); I lost 22 troops and the camp lost 187. At bell 64 Mive sent a message and Fjordal sent an army of 300 troops from (3,-3). At bell 66 my mine was finished. At bell 67 Daraos attacked my army at (2,-3) and I lost 37 troops.
